'''Esprix Estate''' was the official residence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The palace was built in an ornate style reminiscent of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] school of architecture. It was also the base of [[Esseles's spynet|Esseles's Spynet]]. From there Esseles's spymasters directed an extended network of [[operative]]s.<ref name="CCW" />
